finding: Selective decisions can hide a disproportionate share of default information.
confirmatory_or_posthoc: Cross-dataset descriptive plus frozen formal evidence
limitations: PPDai hidden-default fraction unavailable; only four datasets.

finding: Feedback recovery does not imply proportional downstream recovery.
limitations: Does not imply feedback recovery has no effect.

finding: Quantity-first safe acquisition captures most observed practical value under LRBE.
limitations: Not universal optimality; PPDai label counts are small.

finding: FAVE changes acquired-feedback composition but lacks stable downstream superiority.
limitations: Applicant-level boundary evidence unavailable; FAVE is not useless.

finding: Sophisticated acquisition value appears conditional on selection severity, risk heterogeneity, and feedback sensitivity.
limitations: Factors are not experimentally orthogonal, causal, universal, or necessary-and-sufficient.

finding: Evaluation distortion and genuine model degradation are distinct consequences of selective labels.
limitations: Not claimed as novel in isolation.
